Question 10

Find f(x,y,z) such that ∇f(x,y,z)=F(x,y,z), where F(x,y,z)=(2x+yez)i+(xez+1)j+(xyez−2z)k.

a
 f(x,y,z)=xyez+x2+x+y2z+C
b
 f(x,y,z)=xyzez+x+y−z2+C
c
f(x,y,z)=xyez+x2+y−z2+C
d
 f(x,y,z)=xez+yx2+x−z2+C
e
 f(x,y,z)=xyez+x+y−z+C
